☀️ Your money this morning, Tuesday 24 November

🇺🇸 Overnight in New York: a huge rebound after last week's sell-off. The Nasdaq jumped 6.5%, the S&P 500 4.7% and the Dow 3.0%, the best day for US shares since April 2025. AI and chip shares led the way, with Nvidia up about 30%.

🌏 Japan's Nikkei is up 3.8% this morning.

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 1.9% higher on Monday.

💱 The rand is steady at about R17.40 to the dollar. Gold is about $3,636 and Brent oil about $89.23.

What it means for you: big swings both ways are a reminder that one week's moves say little about long-term savings.

Prices are 15-minute delayed (06:50). Education, not financial advice.
